professionalSummary.text: Experienced Quantitative Analyst with three years in a retail bank's model validation function, serving as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record.
professionalSummary.witness: Quantitative Analyst, associate grade, in the model validation function of a retail bank for three years, working as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record.

experienceHighlights.text: Performed validation testing on eleven credit risk model validations under the bank's documented validation standard, including replication of model estimates, benchmark model comparison, and stability testing, with test workbooks filed in the validation repository.
experienceHighlights.witness: Performed the validation testing on those reviews under the bank's validation standard: replication of the model estimates, benchmark model comparison and stability testing, with the test workbooks filed in the validation repository.

experienceHighlights.text: Drafted findings sections and open items lists for validation reports, which were edited and signed by the reviewer of record; attended model risk committee meetings with the reviewer of record for four reviews.
experienceHighlights.witness: Drafted the findings sections and the open items list of the validation reports, which the reviewer of record edited and signed; attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four of the reviews.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the review boundary section of validation reports and updated the validation function's testing template following the 2024 standard update.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the review boundary section of each report current and maintained the validation function's testing template after the 2024 standard update.
